email='ka_burt@gmail.com'
sp=apis.spotify.login(username=email,password=spotify_pw)
sp_access=sp['access_token']
fs=apis.file_system.login(username=email,password=file_pw)
fs_access=fs['access_token']

# Ensure backup directory exists
apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path='~/backups', access_token=fs_access, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)


def artists_to_str(artists):
    if not artists:
        return ''
    return '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in artists if a and a.get('name') is not None])


def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# song_id -> (title, artists_str)
songs={}

def add_song(song_id, title, artists_list):
    if song_id is None:
        return
    if song_id not in songs:
        songs[song_id]=(title if title is not None else '', artists_to_str(artists_list))

# 1) Song library
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    items=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=sp_access, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not items:
        break
    print('song_library page',page_index,'items',len(items))
    for s in items:
        add_song(s.get('song_id'), s.get('title',''), s.get('artists',[]))
    page_index+=1
print('songs after song_library',len(songs))

# 2) Album library: fetch each album details to get song titles/artists
page_index=0
album_page_limit=20
album_ids=[]
while True:
    albums=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=sp_access, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=album_page_limit)
    if not albums:
        break
    print('album_library page',page_index,'albums',len(albums))
    for a in albums:
        album_ids.append(a.get('album_id'))
    page_index+=1

print('total albums',len(album_ids))

for idx, aid in enumerate(album_ids):
    al=apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=aid)
    # if artists list missing in songs, show_album should provide
    for song in al.get('songs',[]) or []:
        add_song(song.get('id'), song.get('title',''), song.get('artists',[]))
    if (idx+1)%10==0:
        print('processed albums',idx+1,'songs_so_far',len(songs))
print('songs after album_library',len(songs))

# 3) Playlist library: fetch each playlist details to get song titles/artists
page_index=0
pl_page_limit=20
playlist_ids=[]
while True:
    pls=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=sp_access, query='', is_public=None, page_index=page_index, page_limit=pl_page_limit)
    if not pls:
        break
    print('playlist_library page',page_index,'playlists',len(pls))
    for p in pls:
        playlist_ids.append(p.get('playlist_id'))
    page_index+=1
print('total playlists',len(playlist_ids))

for idx, pid in enumerate(playlist_ids):
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=sp_access)
    for song in pl.get('songs',[]) or []:
        add_song(song.get('id'), song.get('title',''), song.get('artists',[]))
    if (idx+1)%10==0:
        print('processed playlists',idx+1,'songs_so_far',len(songs))
print('songs after playlists',len(songs))

# Build CSV content
rows=[]
for song_id,(title, artists_str) in songs.items():
    rows.append((title, artists_str, song_id))
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower(), x[2]))

csv_lines=['Title,Artists']
for title, artists_str, song_id in rows:
    csv_lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists_str)}")
csv_content='\n'.join(csv_lines)+'\n'

print('csv size bytes',len(csv_content.encode('utf-8')),'unique songs',len(songs))

# Write file
path='~/backups/spotify.csv'
resp=apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=path, access_token=fs_access, content=csv_content, overwrite=True)
print('create_file resp',resp)

# Terminate spotify account

print('delete_account resp',resp_del)

# Complete task
comp=apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=None, status='success')
print('complete_task',comp)

# Re-run backup process with correct playlist library fetching (public + private)

import os

def artists_to_str(artists):
    if not artists:
        return ''
    return '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in artists if a and a.get('name') is not None])

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# Login
pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
file_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
email = 'ka_burt@gmail.com'

sp = apis.spotify.login(username=email, password=spotify_pw)
sp_access = sp['access_token']
fs = apis.file_system.login(username=email, password=file_pw)
fs_access = fs['access_token']

# Ensure backup directory exists
apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path='~/backups', access_token=fs_access, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

songs = {}  # song_id -> (title, artists_str)

def add_song(song_id, title, artists_list):
    if song_id is None:
        return
    if song_id not in songs:
        songs[song_id] = (title if title is not None else '', artists_to_str(artists_list))

# 1) Song library
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    items = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=sp_access, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not items:
        break
    for s in items:
        add_song(s.get('song_id'), s.get('title',''), s.get('artists',[]))
    page_index += 1
print('songs after song_library', len(songs))

# 2) Album library
album_ids = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    albums = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=sp_access, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not albums:
        break
    for a in albums:
        album_ids.append(a.get('album_id'))
    page_index += 1
print('album count', len(album_ids))

for i, aid in enumerate(album_ids):
    al = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=aid)
    for song in (al.get('songs', []) or []):
        add_song(song.get('id'), song.get('title',''), song.get('artists',[]))
    if (i+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('processed albums', i+1, 'songs_so_far', len(songs))

print('songs after album_library', len(songs))

# 3) Playlist library: fetch both public and private playlists
playlist_ids = set()
for is_public in [True, False]:
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        pls = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=sp_access, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not pls:
            break
        for p in pls:
            playlist_ids.add(p.get('playlist_id'))
        page_index += 1
    print('playlist_ids collected for is_public', is_public, 'total', len(playlist_ids))

playlist_ids_list = list(playlist_ids)
print('total playlist count', len(playlist_ids_list))

for i, pid in enumerate(playlist_ids_list):
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=sp_access)
    for song in (pl.get('songs', []) or []):
        add_song(song.get('id'), song.get('title',''), song.get('artists',[]))
    if (i+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('processed playlists', i+1, 'songs_so_far', len(songs))

print('songs after playlist_library', len(songs))

# Write CSV
rows = [(title, artists_str, sid) for sid, (title, artists_str) in songs.items()]
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower(), x[2]))

csv_lines = ['Title,Artists']
for title, artists_str, _ in rows:
    csv_lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists_str)}")
csv_content = '\n'.join(csv_lines) + '\n'

file_path = '~/backups/spotify.csv'
resp = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_access, content=csv_content, overwrite=True)
print('file created', resp)

# Terminate spotify account
resp_del = apis.spotify.delete_account(access_token=sp_access)
print('delete_account', resp_del)
